name: Jamaica

legalStatuses.label: Registered business name
legalStatuses.short: You on your own, or with partners
legalStatuses.plain: You run the business under your own name or a business name. You and the business are the same person for tax. Usually the simplest way to start.

legalStatuses.label: Limited company
legalStatuses.plain: The company is its own legal person, separate from you. It costs more to set up and has more paperwork, but it can limit your personal risk.
legalStatuses.nameRule: Name must end with 'Limited'; registered office must be in Jamaica

launchSteps.label: Get your TRN (Taxpayer Registration Number) from TAJ
launchSteps.plain: A number that identifies you to the tax office. You need it for almost every other step.

launchSteps.label: Choose your business name and check that it is free
launchSteps.plain: If you trade under any name other than your own full name, you must register it. Search the name at COJ first.

launchSteps.label: Register with the Companies Office (COJ)
launchSteps.plain: Online or in person. For a business name, registration lasts three years, then you renew it.

launchSteps.label: Complete the Business Registration Form (BRF1)
launchSteps.plain: One form that also covers your tax and contribution registrations (TRN, NIS, GCT, HEART, NHT).

launchSteps.label: Register as self-employed with TAJ and file your yearly income estimate (form S04A) by March 15
launchSteps.plain: This estimate sets the amount of your quarterly payments to TAJ.

launchSteps.label: Open a separate bank account for the business
launchSteps.plain: Keeping business money apart from household money makes your numbers clearer and your taxes easier to pay.

launchSteps.label: Register as an employer and prepare monthly payroll payments
launchSteps.plain: With employees you pay deductions (income tax, NIS, NHT, Education Tax, HEART/NTA) to TAJ by the 14th of each month.

launchSteps.label: Register for GCT
launchSteps.plain: Required when your yearly sales pass the GCT threshold. Register within 21 days of crossing it.

gct.label: General Consumption Tax (like VAT)
gct.returnDeadline: 25th of the month following the period

corporateIncomeTax.note: Standard rate from secondary sources. Regulated companies pay a higher rate. Confirm with TAJ.

quarterlyPayments.appliesTo: Self-employed statutory payments and estimated corporate income tax

selfEmployedContributions.note: NHT for the self-employed corrected to 3% on 2026-10-03 (NHT website). The earlier draft used 2%.

toVerify: Company income tax rate (25% standard, from secondary sources)
HEART/NTA rule: 3 or more employees and payroll above J$14,444 a month
